display_name: Phase1 受限边界校正学生恢复网络
description: 冻结原 DURA 和 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；仅在源训练中蒸馏特权输入梯度反事实，推理由受限学生从接收和 DURA IQ 预测校正。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发不同于另一个对话的星地恢复网络；只看 Phase1 地面训练测试集；地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；每个星地视图相对同一冻结基座 clean 损失不超过 3 个百分点。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch, FP32, TF32 off; original Phase1 Tri-SIG-TIME immutable release

data.representation: Phase1 R07 source paired received/clean IQ; DURA anchor from received, clean teacher target training only
data.label_map_ref: Phase1 six TX classes; hidden throughout restorer training
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels, V or test IQ during training; clean teacher pseudo-class source only
data.augmentation: Source 20 views then repeat first 10; fixed randomized order with 25% clean identity

permissions.regime: Phase1 L_s/U_s source IQ, frozen DURA and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
permissions.query_use: Fixed student per-record prediction without target adaptation
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed Phase1 development test previously observed, not blind

checkpoint.initialization: Original frozen DURA E20, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME E50, zero-output student field
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA original 7/63/30 source-only metadata and pinned release; F exact original checkpoint ancestry and matching L_s/U_s IDs; DURA SHA bound into field checkpoint
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both inherited Phase1 models are source-only and frozen; generation field from scratch
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed E30, source-paired oracle distillation; no target-dependent selection
checkpoint.recovery: Save immutable per-epoch source model, AdamW, NumPy, PyTorch CPU and assigned CUDA RNG states after durable epoch log and frozen-model verification; source contract and fixed E30 budget strictly checked. Subsequent recovery requires a new registered run, same code commit, stopped failed source, no prior prediction, and one owner across the complete resume lineage.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU true F/G source smoke; shared lock, at most 2 same-user restoration workers and 2 same-user compute processes per card, >=12000 MB; legacy capacity marker; persistent GPU B128 smoke then fresh E30 and prediction
execution.stop_rule: Source or checkpoint mismatch, smoke failure, nonfinite gradient, resource ambiguity, changed frozen weights or incomplete prediction: preserve artifacts; no automatic retry or performance-based stop

metric_names: Tri-SIG-TIME raw clean, per-scene raw and restored accuracy, macro F1 and clean-relative gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.targets_ref: Each of six restored practical scenes within 3 percentage points of same reader raw clean; restored clean degradation at most 1 percentage point

notes: 源反事实显示，在使用配对 clean 基座类别和 clean 范数的特权条件下，2% L2 半径到达源视图 01/20 的 20/21、20/20 个基座困难判断；结果可能是对抗扰动，不是准确率或可部署证明。
源训练计算冻结 F(clean) 伪类别与 F(DURA(received))；仅二者不一致时，以 DURA 输出为起点、干净伪类别为目标进行 12 步输入梯度投影，约束半径为 DURA 自身 L2 的 5%，每步为半径的四分之一。
同意的源记录以 DURA 输出作为零校正目标；学生蒸馏逐条目标，教师不一致记录权重 8，其余权重 1。无 TX 标签、V、测试 IQ，F 和 DURA 权重冻结。
学生网络以接收 IQ 与 DURA 输出为条件，单次 Transformer 校正，逐条 L2 范数不超过 DURA L2 的 5%；推理不接收 clean、类别目标、信道标签或信道方差。该上限不保证物理保真或性能提升。
CPU 实际权重小样本和 GPU B128 smoke 通过后丢弃临时学生权重；归档会物化 512 条 L128/U384 源 IQ，实际 smoke 只选择 L_s。正式训练重新初始化，固定 E30、14790 更新，20 个源视图后重复前 10，25% clean 身份样本。
候选设计时此前 Phase1 开发测试已观察，后续同集非独立盲测。固定 E30，七视图全部 raw/restored 预测保存后才连接真值；不因性能中途停止。
r01 因 N607 CUDA 驱动错误终止且无可恢复权重；r02 固定相同科学配置从头训练，新增每轮完整训练状态。恢复使用新 run，不根据测试成绩选择权重。CPU 合成中断续训得到逐位相同结果；尚需真实 GPU 验证。

rows.method: DURA anchor plus one-pass 5% bounded Transformer student distilled from 12-step source teacher-boundary oracle
rows.purpose: Learn input-only bounded correction from privileged source oracle without clean signal at inference
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026092701, order 2026110104, training noise 2026110105, fixed inference noise template 2026110103; existing Phase1 split and views
rows.scenario: Phase1 R07 L_s/U_s training; fixed Phase1 clean and six practical received views
rows.budget_ref: E30 x63000, batch128, 14790 updates; 12 teacher input-gradient steps on source teacher-disagreement rows only; mismatch weight 8; 25% clean identity
